component.name: hashicorp-vault
component.title: HashiCorp Vault
component.description: Manage secrets in HashiCorp Vault Service
component.label: cloud,cloud

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelHashicorpVaultProducerOperation.label: producer
CamelHashicorpVaultProducerOperation.description: Overrides the desired operation to be used in the producer.

CamelHashicorpVaultSecretPath.label: producer
CamelHashicorpVaultSecretPath.description: Set the desired secret path as header.

CamelHashicorpVaultSecretVersion.label: producer
CamelHashicorpVaultSecretVersion.description: Set the desired secret version as header.

producerIn.description: The fields of the secret for createSecret, the default operation: a Map of the keys and values, a POJO written as JSON, or text, bytes, a stream or a file with a JSON object. A List or no body fails. The other operations take the secret from the secretPath option or the CamelHashicorpVaultSecretPath header

producerOut.description: getSecret gives a Map with the fields of the secret under data and its version under metadata, or no body when the secret does not exist or is deleted. listSecrets gives a List of the names of the secrets in the engine; createSecret and deleteSecret leave the body unchanged

cloud.description: Determine if the Hashicorp Vault is deployed on Hashicorp Cloud or not

host.description: Hashicorp Vault instance host to be used

namespace.description: If the Hashicorp Vault instance is deployed on Hashicorp Cloud, this field will determine the namespace

port.description: Hashicorp Vault instance port to be used

scheme.description: Hashicorp Vault instance scheme to be used

secretPath.description: Hashicorp Vault instance secret Path to be used

authentication.label: security
authentication.description: How to log in to HashiCorp Vault: token (a fixed token), approle (a role ID and a secret ID), kubernetes (the service account token of the pod), jwt (a JWT, such as a workload identity token), cert (the TLS client certificate of the keyStore), aws-iam (the AWS credentials of the application), azure-msi (the Azure managed identity) or gcp-gce (the service account of the Google Compute Engine instance). The token is renewed before it expires, and the endpoint logs in again when the token can no longer be renewed.

authMountPath.label: security
authMountPath.description: The path the login method is mounted at in HashiCorp Vault (without auth/), when it is not the default path of the login method: approle, kubernetes, jwt, cert, aws (for aws-iam), azure (for azure-msi) or gcp (for gcp-gce)

awsIamServerId.label: security
awsIamServerId.description: The value of the X-Vault-AWS-IAM-Server-ID header of the aws-iam login, when the AWS login of HashiCorp Vault requires one (iam_server_id_header_value)

awsRegion.label: security
awsRegion.description: The AWS region the aws-iam login signs its request for, which must be the region of awsStsEndpoint. When not set: us-east-1 with the global endpoint, else the region of the AWS SDK default region chain (such as the AWS_REGION environment variable).

awsStsEndpoint.label: security
awsStsEndpoint.description: The AWS STS endpoint of the aws-iam login, which the AWS login of HashiCorp Vault must accept (its sts_endpoint). When not set, the global endpoint https://sts.amazonaws.com/.

azureClientId.label: security
azureClientId.description: The client ID of a user-assigned managed identity, for the azure-msi login. When not set, the system-assigned managed identity.

azureResource.label: security
azureResource.description: The resource (audience) of the managed identity token of the azure-msi login, which must be the resource of the Azure login of HashiCorp Vault

jwt.label: security
jwt.description: The JWT to log in with, for the jwt and kubernetes logins. For a JWT that is replaced over time, such as a projected service account token, use jwtFile instead.

jwtFile.label: security
jwtFile.description: The file to read the JWT from at every login, for the jwt and kubernetes logins. The kubernetes login reads /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token when neither jwt nor jwtFile is set.

keyStore.label: security
keyStore.description: The file with the TLS client certificate and its private key, which the endpoint presents to HashiCorp Vault: for the cert login, or for a Vault that requires client certificates. A PKCS12 or JKS key store, or PEM with the certificate and its unencrypted private key, in PKCS#8 or, for an RSA key, in PKCS#1.

keyStorePassword.label: security
keyStorePassword.description: The password of the key store and of its private key, when it is a PKCS12 or JKS key store

role.label: security
role.description: The HashiCorp Vault role to log in as, for the kubernetes, jwt, cert, aws-iam, azure-msi and gcp-gce logins. The jwt login can leave it out when the login method has a default role, the aws-iam login to log in as the role named as the IAM principal, and the cert login to let Vault pick the certificate role that trusts the certificate.

roleId.label: security
roleId.description: The role ID of the AppRole, for the approle login

secretId.label: security
secretId.description: The secret ID of the AppRole, for the approle login

token.label: security
token.description: Token to be used, for the token login

trustStore.label: security
trustStore.description: The file with the certificates to trust for the TLS connection to HashiCorp Vault, such as the CA certificate of a private CA: a PKCS12 or JKS trust store, or PEM certificates. When not set, the JVM trusts the certificate as for any other TLS connection.

trustStorePassword.label: security
trustStorePassword.description: The password of the trust store, when it is a PKCS12 or JKS trust store
